equivalent_not_counted.argument: removals list skips ids already in additions: an id in both lists is first added to hits by the additions loop of the same tweak (unless masked or blocklisted, which skip the removal too), and the removals loop skips ids already in hits — so the extra removal entry never reaches the blocklist (gdesktopappinfo.c:1312-1348).

duplicate ids in a tweak list are harmless: mime_lookup skips ids already in hits/blocklist and default_lookup skips ids already in results (gdesktopappinfo.c:1330, :1366), and the first list is stored without dedup in GLib too (expand_strv :862-866).

a removal of an id already in hits only reaches the blocklist under the mutant; the blocklist filters later additions, which also skip ids already in hits, and default() returns at the first loadable result, so an id already collected is never re-decided (gdesktopappinfo.c:1336-1347, :4740-4775).
